scripts.format:check: BASE="$(bun scripts/get-base-branch.mjs)"; if ! git rev-parse --verify "$BASE" > /dev/null; then echo "Base branch $BASE not found"; exit 1; fi; if git diff --name-only "$BASE" -- harness | grep -q .; then cd harness && bun x biome ci --changed --since="$BASE" .; else echo "No changed harness files"; fi
